title: get-snapshot-op
description: Compute an SLO instance summary at a point in time

at.description: The point in time at which to compute the SLO instance summary (ISO 8601 date-time), for example 2023-01-12T10:03:19.000Z

instanceId.description: The SLO instance ID. Omit this parameter or set it to `'*'` to return all instances for the SLO (up to 1000). Set a specific value (for example `host.name:web-01`) to return that instance only.
